handoffs.message: Followup-2 sidecar committed (509b2ee5). Updated from predecessor: corrects SSE event type to research.run.progress, dispatch response shape (queued-confirmation envelope, not ResearchRunProjection), cancel 409 behavior for terminal statuses, If-Match/Idempotency-Key header requirements for dispatch, artifact list shape, and concrete AG-FE-RS-001 TypeScript client signatures. No canonical truth modified. Ready for review.

Review blocked: packet is now stale/inaccurate. AG-BE-RS-002 is archived done (not review_approved) and closeout is no longer an open gate; AG-FE-RS-001 still also depends on AG-FE-SW-002, so do not say it is unblocked only by AG-BE-RS-002 done. Align ResearchRunProjection TS sketch with v4 schema: outcome is pending/pass/fail/inconclusive; metric direction uses target_range; gate_result uses pass/fail/not_applicable/not_evaluated; ResearchFinding requires finding_id and evidence_refs are evidence_ref objects, not string[]; avoid approval text that still says AG-BE-RS-002 review_approved. Scope and canonical boundary are otherwise clean.

Handoff packet updated to fix all reviewer-flagged issues: AG-BE-RS-002 status corrected to done/archived, AG-FE-RS-001 unblock note now mentions AG-FE-SW-002 dependency, ResearchRunProjection TS types aligned with v4 schema (outcome pending/pass/fail/inconclusive, direction target_range, gate_result pass/fail/not_applicable/not_evaluated, ResearchFinding adding finding_id, evidence_refs changed from string[] to EvidenceRef[], EvidenceRef interface added). Reviewer approval text cleaned of review_approved references. Scope and canonical boundary remain clean — no canonical truth modified.

Review blocked: followup-2 packet still has factual/schema drift. After fixing, update the task brief/validation notes so they no longer claim all reviewer issues are fixed while these residual mismatches remain.

Please correct the field-count wording to 26 everywhere before approval; no other factual mismatch found in this pass.
